links.text:
Sam Altman says #Artificial filmed outside his house and he waved to Andrew Garfield:

"One morning I was walking down the street to get coffee, and there were all these cameras and there was a guy dressed exactly like me with my same backpack walking so much that I felt I was in some weird glitch of the simulation or something ... We waved and went on, but it was really weird. I mean, it’s like a strange thing to see someone that has nailed your kind of quirky mannerisms or whatever." https://variety.com/2026/film/news/sam-altman-artificial-filmed-outside-house-waved-andrew-garfield-1236899020/

links.title: Sam Altman Says ‘Artificial’ Filmed Outside His House and He Waved at Andrew Garfield: ‘He Did Walk Like Me … I Felt I Was in Some Weird Glitch of the Simulation’
links.description: Sam Altman says Luca Guadagnino's 'Artificial' filmed outside his house and he waved at Andrew Garfield, who is playing him.
